title: [FEATURE] JSON console formatting for tool input
body: ### Feature Area Core functionality ### Is your feature request related to a an existing bug? Please link it here. Currently tool input looks more like this If there is more inputs then this would be very big string, which might not be very easily readable. ### Describe the solution you'd like Change the formatting for proper JSON readability. ### Describe alternatives you've considered - ### Additional context - ### Willingness to Contribute Yes, I'd be happy to submit a pull request

linked_prs.title: Added JSON loads before dumping
linked_prs.patch:
diff --git a/src/crewai/events/utils/console_formatter.py b/src/crewai/events/utils/console_formatter.py
index d2418c73e9..c76853d02c 100644
--- a/src/crewai/events/utils/console_formatter.py
+++ b/src/crewai/events/utils/console_formatter.py
@@ -1377,7 +1377,7 @@ def handle_agent_logs_execution(
         if isinstance(formatted_answer, AgentAction):
             thought = re.sub(r"\n+", "\n", formatted_answer.thought)
             formatted_json = json.dumps(
-                formatted_answer.tool_input,
+                json.loads(formatted_answer.tool_input),
                 indent=2,
                 ensure_ascii=False,
             )
